title: Kimi K3.1 Pro extends Moonshot's agent model to 1M-token context
dek: Moonshot's new 3T-class model emphasizes long-horizon coding and financial research with a faster serving tier.
evidence: Moonshot model and product descriptions; benchmark and throughput claims vendor-reported
takeaway: Evaluate effective long-context retrieval and cost per completed task, not nominal context length.

sections.title: Model and serving

bullets.detail: Moonshot describes K3.1 Pro as a 3T-class model with up to one million tokens of context, available in Kimi Code with thinking modes.
The separate K3.1 Pro Highspeed tier is claimed to provide roughly 2–3× throughput at the same output quality.

paragraphs: Context: Moonshot describes K3.1 Pro as a 3T-class model with up to one million tokens of context, available in Kimi Code with thinking modes.
Highspeed: The separate K3.1 Pro Highspeed tier is claimed to provide roughly 2–3× throughput at the same output quality.

sections.title: Evaluation priorities

bullets.detail: Maximum context size and provider throughput do not measure recall fidelity across long documents or the total latency of tool-heavy workflows.
Use long-document evidence attribution, codebase navigation and multi-step finance research; measure retrieval accuracy, cost, time to first token and completion-level success.
